items.name: Fish
items.source: REDESIGN-PLAN.md, food web table (plankton, insects, smaller fish)

body_mass_kg.source: assumption (docs/DECISIONS.md): typical body mass of the species that fill this guild

reach_m.source: assumption: height of the food the guild can reach

move_km_per_month.source: assumption: typical monthly range shift; seasonal migrants go further (docs/DECISIONS.md)

assimilation.source: assumption: typical assimilation efficiency of the diet class (herbivores 0.4 to 0.6, carnivores 0.8 to 0.9)

intake_coefficient.source: assumption, tuned so that large herbivores reach about 1 to 5 g C per m2 on savanna (Serengeti large herbivore biomass is about 2e4 kg/km2 wet): maximum intake in kgC per kgC of body per year at 1 kg body mass, scaled by mass to the minus one quarter (Brown et al. 2004)

respiration_coefficient.source: assumption, tuned: respiration in kgC per kgC of body per year at 1 kg body mass, scaled by mass to the minus one quarter (Brown et al. 2004)

mortality_coefficient.source: assumption, tuned: natural mortality per year at 1 kg body mass, scaled by mass to the minus one quarter

half_saturation_food.source: assumption, tuned: leaf carbon density at which a herbivore eats half its maximum, kgC/m2 (Holling type II)

scaling_exponent.source: Brown et al. 2004, Toward a metabolic theory of ecology: rates scale as mass to the minus one quarter

half_saturation_prey.source: assumption, tuned: prey carbon density at which a predator eats half its maximum, kgC/m2

disease_density.source: assumption: biomass density, kgC/m2, at which crowding disease doubles mortality
